cib.name: Combat Infantryman Badge
cib.text: The first unit you deploy each combat gains 4 Cover.

bronze_star.name: Bronze Star
bronze_star.text: +1 Command on the first turn of each combat.

field_manual.name: Field Manual
field_manual.text: Draw 1 extra card on the first turn of each combat.

lucky_zippo.name: Lucky Zippo
lucky_zippo.text: The first unit that would die each combat survives at 1 HP.

signal_flare.name: Signal Flare
signal_flare.text: At the start of combat, all enemies are Exposed for 1 turn.

spare_parts.name: Spare Parts Crate
spare_parts.text: Workshops let you do two jobs instead of one.

dog_tags.name: Dog Tags
dog_tags.text: Cards are lost after 4 casualties instead of 3.

mess_kit.name: Mess Kit
mess_kit.text: Resting at a Field Aid Station heals 15 more Resolve.

engineers_manual.name: Engineer's Manual
engineers_manual.text: Your units deploy with 2 extra Cover.
